titulo: Laptop makers, I’m begging you to put USB-C ports on both sides

titulo: Neural network spots previously missed epilepsy signs on brain MRIs
resumo: Researchers from the joint Biomedically-Informed AI Laboratory of Skoltech (a VEB.RF Group institution) and the University of Sharjah and their colleagues have improved the performance of computer vision algorithms that look for signs of epilepsy and multiple sclerosis on brain MRI scans. Rather than merely analyzing an image as a set of pixels, the neural network now also attends to medical features known to physicians. This is complemented by the machine's capability to spot subtle details that elude the human eye. In the future, such solutions will help doctors diagnose diseases and select treatment strategies.

titulo: Guideline on shorter-course radiation therapy for localized prostate cancer updated
resumo: An updated clinical guideline from the American Society for Radiation Oncology (ASTRO) provides evidence-based recommendations on the use of hypofractionated radiation therapy for patients with localized prostate cancer. The guideline replaces ASTRO's 2018 recommendations and reflects a matured evidence base showing that shorter-course radiation therapy can maintain cancer control while reducing overall treatment burden for patients receiving definitive external beam radiation therapy (EBRT). The guideline was published in Practical Radiation Oncology.

titulo: A single sauna session sends immune cells surging through your body
resumo: A new Finnish study reveals that just 30 minutes in a sauna can temporarily flood the bloodstream with additional white blood cells, potentially helping the immune system patrol the body and detect threats. The surprising response resembles the immune boost seen during exercise and may help explain some of the health benefits linked to sauna bathing.

titulo: New feed supplement addresses honey bee declines after blueberry pollination

titulo: Improve IBD bowel checks for early cancer detection
resumo: The first U.K.-wide analysis of bowel screening for patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) has identified opportunities to improve the early detection of cancer. The study—the largest of its kind globally—found that checks performed by professionals with regular experience, more time allowed for the procedure and the use of a special dye to improve visibility were each associated with finding small growths called polyps, which may become cancer.

titulo: Cooperation in fish: Study reveals a social complexity seen mainly in birds, mammals
resumo: In some group-living animals, individuals other than the parents help care for offspring. This breeding system, known as cooperative breeding, is thought to have evolved from monogamous family groups in which offspring remain in their natal group and engage in various cooperative behaviors, including helping to care for younger siblings. Cooperative breeding has been documented in mammals and birds.

titulo: Israeli ad tech firm tied to suspected Starlink tracking effort, report claims
resumo: Citizen Lab and Confiant linked Israeli firm Discover-Tech to suspected surveillance through online advertising. Researchers said its ads appeared across nearly 200,000 websites and mobile apps. TrendAI separately identified related activity under the codename “SHADOW-EARTH-79.” The findings raise concerns about ad auctions being exploited to track users across sensitive networks, though ad impressions alone do not confirm spyware infections.

titulo: Targeting fat-cell enzyme offers potential strategy to reduce obesity and cancer risk
resumo: Obesity touches countless lives across the country and can lead to many other health complications. From August 2021 to 2023, the prevalence of obesity in adults in the U.S. was more than 40%. Research published in Science Advances, led by scientists at VCU Massey Comprehensive Cancer Center, found that targeting fat cells specifically with inhibitors of the enzyme sphingosine kinase 2 could be a new strategy to combat obesity and lower the risk of its comorbidities like cancer.

titulo: Google Fotos ganha visual redesenhado e agora deixa usuário personalizar aba "Álbuns"
resumo: O Google Fotos começou a liberar uma nova interface para o aplicativo no Android e iOS, com mais opções para personalizar a aba “Álbuns” . Com a atualização, a página é organizada em carrossel e grades, e traz a possibilidade de ocultar seções, alterar a ordem dos itens e escolher como os conteúdos aparecem na tela. A mudança dá continuidade à reformulação iniciada em julho, quando o aplicativo recebeu uma barra de navegação flutuante. No layout anterior, a página começava com uma grade de quatro atalhos , com “Favoritos” e “Lixeira” fixados na parte superior. Os outros dois espaços mostravam opções que variavam conforme o uso do aplicativo. Abaixo, os cartões maiores davam acesso a “Álbuns”, “Neste dispositivo”, “Pessoas e animais de estimação”, “Guarda-roupa”, “Documentos”, “Lugares”, “Figurinhas” e “Momentos”. No Android, a página tinha uma lista de atalhos na parte inferior , com as opções “Capturas de tela”, “Vídeos”, “Adicionados recentemente”, “Arquivo” e “Pasta trancada”. Com o novo visual, a seção “Fixados” aparece no topo com um carrossel que inclui “Favoritos”, “Prints” e “Lixeira” por padrão. O usuário pode remover essa seção e reorganizar os demais elementos da página.

titulo: Robinson: Raspberry Pi 5 on Fedora
resumo: Peter Robinson has written a blog post about the current state of Fedora support for Raspberry Pi 5 devices. According to Robinson, the upcoming Fedora 45 release will work—with caveats—on all variants of the Raspberry Pi Model 5B; the Compute Module 5 and Pi 500+ are still works in progress. For Fedora 44 release you need to have a temporary workaround when booting. If you update to the latest kernel/firmware straight away this isn't then needed beyond the first boot. The workaround isn't needed for Fedora 45 so if you're going to try this out I suggest you go and grab your favourite flavour of Fedora from the Fedora 45 release candidates and jump straight in there! You will get an accelerated desktop with storage/network/USB. There's not currently any support for sound and a number of other things. See Robinson's post for instructions on creating an Fedora image to use with a Raspberry Pi 5.

titulo: Caminhão elétrico da Tesla pega fogo e interdita rodovia

As equipes de combate também precisaram lidar com as particularidades do fogo em baterias de grande capacidade , como as encontradas em veículos elétricos. Segundo a polícia rodoviária da Califórnia, o motorista relatou que o caminhão começou a pegar fogo, mas não soube explicar a causa. Não houve registro imediato de feridos , e as circunstâncias do incidente continuavam sob investigação . Bateria dificultou o combate ao incêndio O fogo começou na noite de terça-feira , 27 de outubro, e levou as autoridades a interditar os dois sentidos da rodovia inicialmente.
